58/S0.subgoal: Describe the stages of the 3D graphics pipeline and the scope of the lecture.

58/S1.subgoal: Describe the first four stages of the 3D graphics pipeline.

58/S2.subgoal: Explain the fifth stage of the graphics pipeline, scan conversion, and how it maps continuous coordinates to a discrete pixel grid.

58/S3.subgoal: Describe how Bresenham's algorithm provides an efficient method for line rendering by avoiding floating-point operations.

58/S4.subgoal: Explain the aliasing effect and the computational challenges specific to rendering in virtual reality.

58/S5.subgoal: Describe how graphics libraries and APIs facilitate the software implementation of the graphics pipeline.

58/S6.subgoal: Describe how GPUs exploit inherent parallelism to speed up the graphics pipeline.
